verses.original: וּמָרְדֳּכַ֗י יָדַע֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשָׂ֔ה מָרְדֳּכַי֙ אֶת־ וַיִּקְרַ֤ע בְּגָדָ֔יו וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ שַׂ֖ק וָאֵ֑פֶר וַיֵּצֵא֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֔יר וַיִּזְעַ֛ק זְעָקָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה וּמָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·rə·do·ḵay yā·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer na·‘ă·śāh mā·rə·do·ḵay ’eṯ- way·yiq·ra‘ bə·ḡā·ḏāw way·yil·baš śaq wā·’ê·p̄er way·yê·ṣê bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘îr way·yiz·‘aq zə·‘ā·qāh ḡə·ḏō·lāh ū·mā·rāh
verses.literal: When Mordecai learned of - all that had happened he - tore his clothes put on sackcloth and ashes and went out into the middle of the city wailing . . . loudly and bitterly

verses.original: וַיָּב֕וֹא עַ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ שַֽׁעַר־ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין בִּלְב֥וּשׁ שָֽׂק׃ לָב֛וֹא אֶל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ שַׁ֥עַר
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w ‘aḏ lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ ša·‘ar- kî ’ên bil·ḇūš śāq lā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·me·leḵ ša·‘ar
verses.literal: But he went only as . . . far as the king’s gate because the law prohibited anyone wearing sackcloth from entering . . . [that] gate

verses.original: וּבְכָל־ מְדִינָ֣ה וּמְדִינָ֗ה מְקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דְּבַר־ וְדָתוֹ֙ מַגִּ֔יעַ גָּדוֹל֙ אֵ֤בֶל לַיְּהוּדִ֔ים וְצ֥וֹם וּבְכִ֖י וּמִסְפֵּ֑ד לָֽרַבִּֽים׃ יֻצַּ֖ע שַׂ֣ק וָאֵ֔פֶר
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḵāl mə·ḏî·nāh ū·mə·ḏî·nāh mə·qō·wm ’ă·šer ham·me·leḵ də·ḇar- wə·ḏā·ṯōw mag·gî·a‘ gā·ḏō·wl ’ê·ḇel lay·yə·hū·ḏîm wə·ṣō·wm ū·ḇə·ḵî ū·mis·pêḏ lā·rab·bîm yuṣ·ṣa‘ śaq wā·’ê·p̄er
verses.literal: In every province . . . to which - the king’s command and edict came there was great mourning among the Jews They fasted wept and lamented and many lay in sackcloth and ashes

verses.original: אֶסְתֵּ֤ר נַעֲר֨וֹת וְסָרִיסֶ֙יהָ֙ וַ֠תָּבוֹאינָה וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ לָ֔הּ הַמַּלְכָּ֖ה וַתִּתְחַלְחַ֥ל מְאֹ֑ד וַתִּשְׁלַ֨ח בְּגָדִ֜ים מָרְדֳּכַ֗י לְהַלְבִּ֣ישׁ אֶֽת־ וּלְהָסִ֥יר שַׂקּ֛וֹ מֵעָלָ֖יו וְלֹ֥א קִבֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’es·têr na·‘ă·rō·wṯ wə·sā·rî·se·hā wat·tå̄·ḇō·nå̄h way·yag·gî·ḏū lāh ham·mal·kāh wat·tiṯ·ḥal·ḥal mə·’ōḏ wat·tiš·laḥ bə·ḡā·ḏîm mā·rə·do·ḵay lə·hal·bîš ’eṯ- ū·lə·hā·sîr śaq·qōw mê·‘ā·lāw wə·lō qib·bêl
verses.literal: When Esther’s maidens and eunuchs came and told her [about Mordecai] the queen was overcome with distress . . . She sent clothes for Mordecai to wear - instead of his sackcloth . . . but he would not accept them

verses.original: אֶסְתֵּ֨ר וַתִּקְרָא֩ לַהֲתָ֜ךְ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִסָּרִיסֵ֤י הֶעֱמִ֣יד לְפָנֶ֔יהָ וַתְּצַוֵּ֖הוּ עַֽל־ מָרְדֳּכָ֑י לָדַ֥עַת מַה־ זֶּ֖ה וְעַל־ מַה־ זֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’es·têr wat·tiq·rā la·hă·ṯāḵ ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer mis·sā·rî·sê he·‘ĕ·mîḏ lə·p̄ā·ne·hā wat·tə·ṣaw·wê·hū ‘al- mā·rə·do·ḵāy lā·ḏa·‘aṯ mah- zeh wə·‘al- mah- zeh
verses.literal: Then Esther summoned Hathach one of the king’s - eunuchs appointed to her and she dispatched him to Mordecai to learn what was troubling him . . . and why . . . . . .

verses.original: הֲתָ֖ךְ וַיֵּצֵ֥א אֶֽל־ מָרְדֳּכָ֑י אֶל־ הָעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֖ר רְח֣וֹב לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ שַֽׁעַר־
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯāḵ way·yê·ṣê ’el- mā·rə·do·ḵāy ’el- hā·‘îr ’ă·šer rə·ḥō·wḇ lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ ša·‘ar-
verses.literal: So Hathach went out to Mordecai in the city - square in front of the king’s gate

verses.original: מָרְדֳּכַ֔י אֵ֖ת וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֣וֹ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרָ֑הוּ וְאֵ֣ת׀ פָּרָשַׁ֣ת הַכֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָמָן֙ אָמַ֤ר לִ֠שְׁקוֹל עַל־ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ גִּנְזֵ֥י לְאַבְּדָֽם׃ בַּיְּהוּדִיִּים
verses.transliteration: mā·rə·do·ḵay ’êṯ way·yag·geḏ- lōw kāl- ’ă·šer qā·rā·hū wə·’êṯ pā·rā·šaṯ hak·ke·sep̄ ’ă·šer hā·mān ’ā·mar liš·qō·wl ‘al- ham·me·leḵ gin·zê lə·’ab·bə·ḏām bay·yə·hū·ḏī·yīm
verses.literal: and Mordecai - told him all that had happened to him including the exact amount of money that Haman had promised to pay into the royal treasury in order to destroy the Jews

verses.original: וְאֶת־ נִתַּ֨ן פַּתְשֶׁ֣גֶן כְּתָֽב־ הַ֠דָּת אֲשֶׁר־ נָ֣תַן ל֔וֹ בְּשׁוּשָׁ֤ן לְהַשְׁמִידָם֙ לְהַרְא֥וֹת וּלְהַגִּ֣יד אֶת־ אֶסְתֵּ֖ר לָ֑הּ וּלְצַוּ֣וֹת עָלֶ֗יהָ לָב֨וֹא אֶל־ הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ לְהִֽתְחַנֶּן־ ל֛וֹ וּלְבַקֵּ֥שׁ מִלְּפָנָ֖יו עַל־ עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- nit·tan paṯ·še·ḡen kə·ṯāḇ- had·dāṯ ’ă·šer- nā·ṯan lōw bə·šū·šān lə·haš·mî·ḏām lə·har·’ō·wṯ ū·lə·hag·gîḏ ’eṯ- ’es·têr lāh ū·lə·ṣaw·wō·wṯ ‘ā·le·hā lā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·me·leḵ lə·hiṯ·ḥan·nen- lōw ū·lə·ḇaq·qêš mil·lə·p̄ā·nāw ‘al- ‘am·māh
verses.literal: - Mordecai also gave [Hathach] a copy of the written decree - issued in Susa for the destruction [of the Jews] to show and explain to Esther urging her to approach . . . the king implore his favor and plead before him for her people

verses.original: הֲתָ֑ךְ וַיָּב֖וֹא וַיַּגֵּ֣ד מָרְדֳּכָֽי׃ דִּבְרֵ֥י לְאֶסְתֵּ֔ר אֵ֖ת
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯāḵ way·yā·ḇō·w way·yag·gêḏ mā·rə·do·ḵāy diḇ·rê lə·’es·têr ’êṯ
verses.literal: So Hathach went back and relayed Mordecai’s response to Esther -

verses.original: אֶסְתֵּר֙ וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לַהֲתָ֔ךְ וַתְּצַוֵּ֖הוּ אֶֽל־ מָרְדֳּכָֽי׃
verses.literal: Then Esther spoke to Hathach and instructed him to tell Mordecai

verses.original: כָּל־ הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ עַבְדֵ֣י וְעַם־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ מְדִינ֨וֹת יֽוֹדְעִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַחַ֤ת דָּתוֹ֙ כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבֽוֹא־ אֶל־ הַמֶּלֶךְ֩ אֶל־ הַפְּנִימִ֜ית הֶחָצֵ֨ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יִקָּרֵ֗א לְהָמִ֔ית לְ֠בַד מֵאֲשֶׁ֨ר הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת־ יֽוֹשִׁיט־ ל֥וֹ הַזָּהָ֖ב שַׁרְבִ֥יט וְחָיָ֑ה וַאֲנִ֗י לֹ֤א נִקְרֵ֙אתי֙ לָב֣וֹא אֶל־ זֶ֖ה הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שְׁלוֹשִׁ֥ים יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ham·me·leḵ ‘aḇ·ḏê wə·‘am- ham·me·leḵ mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ yō·wḏ·‘îm ’ă·šer ’a·ḥaṯ dā·ṯōw kāl- ’îš wə·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer yā·ḇō·w- ’el- ham·me·leḵ ’el- hap·pə·nî·mîṯ he·ḥā·ṣêr ’ă·šer lō- yiq·qā·rê lə·hā·mîṯ lə·ḇaḏ mê·’ă·šer ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- yō·wō·šîṭ- lōw haz·zā·hāḇ šar·ḇîṭ wə·ḥā·yāh wa·’ă·nî lō niq·rē·ṯ lā·ḇō·w ’el- zeh ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·wō·šîm yō·wm
verses.literal: All the royal officials and the people of the king’s provinces know that one law applies to every man or woman who approaches . . . the king in the inner court without . . . being summoned that he be put to death Only if - the king - extends the gold scepter may that person live But I have not been summoned to appear before the king for the past thirty days
When Esther’s words were relayed to Mordecai -

verses.original: מָרְדֳּכַ֖י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ אֶסְתֵּ֑ר לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַל־ תְּדַמִּ֣י בְנַפְשֵׁ֔ךְ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּית־ לְהִמָּלֵ֥ט מִכָּל־ הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mā·rə·do·ḵay way·yō·mer ’el- ’es·têr lə·hā·šîḇ ’al- tə·ḏam·mî ḇə·nap̄·šêḵ ham·me·leḵ bêṯ- lə·him·mā·lêṭ mik·kāl hay·yə·hū·ḏîm
verses.literal: he sent back to [her] this reply Do not imagine that [because] you are in the king’s palace you alone will escape the fate of all the Jews

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישִׁי֮ הַזֹּאת֒ בָּעֵ֣ת רֶ֣וַח וְהַצָּלָ֞ה לַיְּהוּדִים֙ יַעֲמ֤וֹד אַחֵ֔ר מִמָּק֣וֹם וְאַ֥תְּ אָבִ֖יךְ וּבֵית־ תֹּאבֵ֑דוּ וּמִ֣י יוֹדֵ֔עַ אִם־ הִגַּ֖עַתְּ לַמַּלְכֽוּת׃ לְעֵ֣ת כָּזֹ֔את
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ha·ḥă·rêš ta·ḥă·rî·šî haz·zōṯ bā·‘êṯ re·waḥ wə·haṣ·ṣā·lāh lay·yə·hū·ḏîm ya·‘ă·mō·wḏ ’a·ḥêr mim·mā·qō·wm wə·’at ’ā·ḇîḵ ū·ḇêṯ- tō·ḇê·ḏū ū·mî yō·w·ḏê·a‘ ’im- hig·ga·‘at lam·mal·ḵūṯ lə·‘êṯ kā·zōṯ
verses.literal: For if you remain silent . . . at this time relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place but you and your father’s house will perish And who knows if perhaps you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this
Then Esther sent this reply to Mordecai

verses.original: לֵךְ֩ כְּנ֨וֹס אֶת־ כָּל־ הַיְּהוּדִ֜ים הַֽנִּמְצְאִ֣ים בְּשׁוּשָׁ֗ן וְצ֣וּמוּ עָ֠לַי וְאַל־ תֹּאכְל֨וּ וְאַל־ תִּשְׁתּ֜וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ לַ֣יְלָה וָי֔וֹם אֲנִ֥י וְנַעֲרֹתַ֖י גַּם־ אָצ֣וּם כֵּ֑ן וּבְכֵ֞ן אָב֤וֹא אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ כַדָּ֔ת וְכַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָבַ֖דְתִּי אָבָֽדְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ kə·nō·ws ’eṯ- kāl- hay·yə·hū·ḏîm han·nim·ṣə·’îm bə·šū·šān wə·ṣū·mū ‘ā·lay wə·’al- tō·ḵə·lū wə·’al- tiš·tū šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm lay·lāh wā·yō·wm ’ă·nî wə·na·‘ă·rō·ṯay gam- ’ā·ṣūm kên ū·ḇə·ḵên ’ā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer lō- ḵad·dāṯ wə·ḵa·’ă·šer ’ā·ḇaḏ·tî ’ā·ḇā·ḏə·tî
verses.literal: Go and assemble - all the Jews who can be found in Susa and fast for me Do not eat . . . or drink for three days night or day and I and my maidens - will fast as you do After that I will go to the king even though it is against the law And if I perish I perish

verses.original: מָרְדֳּכָ֑י וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ אֶסְתֵּֽר׃ס צִוְּתָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו
verses.literal: So Mordecai went and did all that Esther had instructed him
